Also yarn build:production is now essentially the same command as yarn build:production:ivy in the example project now that Ivy is enabled by default as of next.3

issue.title: Failure tracking summary

repository.name: ngcc-validation
repository.description: Angular Ivy library compatibility validation project

issue.body:
Given that many failures fall under the same root causes, I think it makes sense (at least it helps me :grin:) to have a summary of the failures grouped by root cause. This is what this is issue is for.

For completeness, related info is also captured [here](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1TEawfLbWQjqTDst2Jrm2KF6udMVMjuKiz8LG4NPD7WQ) and [there](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1brJHrqGYGGD4HRsFudGW6CynHHX34Zf8H31qD7wjPac).

<sub>_Last update: 2019-11-06_</sub>

---

## 1. With pending PR to fix

_Projects that are currently failing, but for which there is a pending PR to fix them._

- [x] **alfrescoadf-core-ngcc**: Alfresco/alfresco-ng2-components#5153


## 2. Transitive failures

_Projects that are failing due to some of their dependencies' failing and those dependencies also happen to have their own project in this repo._

- [x] **nebularauth-ngcc**: Failing dep: `@nebular/theme` (project: `nebulartheme-ngcc`) (fixed by angular/angular#33264, #466)
- [x] **nebulardate-fns-ngcc**: Failing dep `@nebular/theme` (project: `nebulartheme-ngcc`) (fixed by angular/angular#33264, #466)
- [x] **nebulareva-icons-ngcc**: Failing dep: `@nebular/theme` (project: `nebulartheme-ngcc`) (fixed by angular/angular#33264, #466)
- [x] **nebularmoment-ngcc**: Failing dep: `@nebular/theme` (project: `nebulartheme-ngcc`) (fixed by angular/angular#33264, #466)
- [x] **ngx-chips-ngcc**: Failing dep: `ng2-material-dropdown` (project: `ng2-material-dropdown-ngcc`) (fixed by #400)


## 3. Importing removed `Renderer`

_Projects that are failing, because they try to import `Renderer`, which is removed in v9. This is a v9 breaking change - not `ngcc`-specific._

- [ ] **angular-froala-wysiwyg-ngcc** (fix froala/angular-froala-wysiwyg#349, issue froala/angular-froala-wysiwyg#347)
- [x] **angular-tree-component-ngcc** (fixed by #521)
- [x] **mobx-angular-ngcc** (mobxjs/mobx-angular#93)
- [ ] **mydatepicker-ngcc** (kekeh/mydatepicker#624)
- [ ] **ng2-completer-ngcc** (oferh/ng2-completer#437)
- [x] **ng2-material-dropdown-ngcc** (Gbuomprisco/ng2-material-dropdown#66) (fixed by #399)


## 4. Missing type argument in `ngBaseDef`

_Projects that are failing, because of missing type arguments in the generated `ngBaseDef` declaration. `ngBaseDef` will soon go away in `ngtsc` and be replaced by `ngDirectiveDef`. (We should make sure that the problem is fixed then.)_

- [x] **delonform-ngcc**: "Generic type 'Widget<T, UIT>' requires 2 type argument(s)" (fixed by angular/angular#33264, #466)
- [x] **nebulartheme-ngcc**: "Generic type 'NbBasePicker<D, T, P>' requires 3 type argument(s)" (fixed by angular/angular#33264, #466)
- [x] **ng-pick-datetime-ngcc** : "Generic type 'OwlDateTime<T>' requires 1 type argument(s)" (fixed by angular/angular#33264, #466)


## 5. Failed to reflect on node

_Projects that are failing due to failing to find the exported name of a node (due to not using the `ReflectionHost` when we should). This is tracked in [FW-1508](https://angular-team.atlassian.net/browse/FW-1508). More details in #57._

- [ ] **angularx-social-login-ngcc** (abacritt/angularx-social-login#229)


## 6. Not resolved to `NgModule` class

_Projects that are failing with the following error:  
`Appears in the NgModule.imports of AppModule, but could not be resolved to an NgModule class`_

- [ ] **carbonicons-angular-ngcc**
- [x] **ng2-file-upload-ngcc** (Potentially related: #284, valor-software/ng2-file-upload#1107) (fixed by #451)


## 7. Can't resolve `fs`

_Haven't looked into this one yet, but these projects are failing with the same error:  
`Module not found: Error: Can't resolve 'fs' in '.../__ivy_ngcc__/fesm5'`_

- [x] **nguniversalaspnetcore-engine-ngcc** (fixed by #388)
- [x] **nguniversalexpress-engine-ngcc** (fixed by #388)


## 8. Runtime errors

_Projects that are failing due to errors at runtime, despite the build having completed successfully._

- [x] **ng-bootstrapng-bootstrap-ngcc**: "Error: It looks like your application or one of its depen…gular/localize/init';` to your polyfills.ts file)" (fixed by #441)
- [x] **ng2-dragula-ngcc**: "ReferenceError: global is not defined" (fixed by #430)
- [ ] **ng6-breadcrumbs-ngcc**: "ReferenceError: exports is not defined" (angular/angular#33297)
    _Probably not worth supporting this one._
- [x] **ngx-formlymaterial-ngcc**: "TypeError: Cannot set property 'ɵfac' of undefined" (fixed by angular/angular#33533, #522)
- [ ] **ngx-simple-modal-ngcc**: "ReferenceError: exports is not defined" (will be fixed by #475 and/or KevCJones/ngx-simple-modal#61)
- [ ] **uirouterangular-ngcc**: "TypeError: Cannot read property 'createComponent' of undefined" (angular/angular#32166, https://github.com/ui-router/angular/issues/516#issuecomment-539767843)


## 9. Other causes

_Projects that are failing for other reasons (I haven't looked into yet). (See failure errors below for more info.)_

- [ ] **covalentcore-ngcc**: "Tried to overwrite X.d.ts.__ivy_ngcc_bak with an ngcc back up file, which is disallowed"
- [ ] **harborui-ngcc**: "The target entry-point "@harbor/ui" has missing dependencies: @nguniversal/express-engine/tokens"
- [ ] **kendo-ui-ngcc**: "Unsupported binary operator: InKeyword" (Related: angular/angular#33453)
- [x] **mobx-angular-ngcc**: "TypeError: Cannot read property 'component' of undefined" (fixed by mobxjs/mobx-angular#94, #513) 
- [ ] **nativescript-angular-ngcc**: Tries to import `ɵDomAdapter`.
- [ ] **uirouterangular-hybrid-ngcc**: "ERROR in Symbol UIRouterModule declared in /home/circleci/repo/node_modules/@uirouter/angular/lib/uiRouterNgModule.d.ts is not exported from @uirouter/angular-hybrid (import into /home/circleci/repo/projects/uirouterangular-hybrid-ngcc/src/app/child.module.ts)" (angular/angular#32166, [FW-1652](https://angular-team.atlassian.net/browse/FW-1652))(fixed by angular/angular#33495?)


## 10. Other reported failures (not necessarily part of `ngcc-validation`)

_Packages that have been reported to be failing in Ivy, but are currently not tested against in this repo. Listing them here to have a single point of reference for known Ivy/`ngcc` failures._

- [ ] **@grapecity/wijmo.angular2.all**
- [ ] **@momentum-ui/angular** (#374)
- [ ] **@swimlane/ngx-charts** (angular/angular#30512, #497) (fixed by angular/angular#33555?)
- [ ] **@syncfusion/ej2-angular-grids** (angular/angular#30818)
- [x] **devextreme-angular** (angular/angular#31311, angular/ngcc-validation#492)
- [ ] **ion2-calendar** (angular/angular#33153)
- [x] **ng2-charts** (angular/angular#32748)
- [ ] **ng2-device-detector**/**ngx-device-detector** failing due to **ngx-highlightjs** (angular/angular#31616)
- [ ] **ng2-pdfjs-viewer** (angular/angular#31629)
- [ ] **ngx-auth-firebaseui**
- [ ] **ngx-segment-analytics** (angular/angular#31912)
- [x] **ngx-socket-io** (angular/angular#32242): Seems to work with latest version. (Verified manually by Pete; hard to write e2e test due to Socket server requirement.)
- [ ] **primeng** (angular/angular#30565)

---

issue.body:
Previously declarations that were imported via a namespace import
were given the same `bestGuessOwningModule` as the context
where they were imported to. This causes problems with resolving
`ModuleWithProviders` that have a type that has been imported in
this way, causing errors like:

```
ERROR in Symbol UIRouterModule declared in
.../@uirouter/angular/uiRouterNgModule.d.ts
is not exported from
.../@uirouter/angular/uirouter-angular.d.ts
(import into .../src/app/child.module.ts)
```

This commit modifies the `TypescriptReflectionHost.getDirectImportOfIdentifier()`
method so that it also understands how to attach the correct `viaModule` to
the identifier of the namespace import.

Resolves #32166
